what: A strip pinned to the screen bottom. By the scroll progress ratio, the car (the image) runs within the strip width minus the car width, and the strip pattern (background) is pushed back the same distance in the opposite direction. Only while it moves more than 3px does the car outline darken to ink color (.2s, and after it stops it fades in .2s following a .1s wait). The car also flips to face its direction of travel. It stops at both ends, and at the right end it turns around so it can be pressed. If the overflow distance is under 150px, the car just stops at the right end, turned around

options.scroller: Selector for the panel that overflows horizontally and vertically — if none, the [data-fx-scroller] ancestor, otherwise window scroll
options.axis: x · y — default is x if there is a panel, y if it is a window
options.min: If it overflows by no more than this (px), it counts as stopped (is-fx-noscroll), default 150
options.--fx-height · --fx-car: Band height · car width (via style), default 5.5rem · 5rem
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Pattern panel (background-image is supplied by the consumer) — optional
options.[data-fx-part=car]: Running car (must be present). Its first child (svg) is flipped and its color changes — draw the border with currentColor
options.fx:scroll: Scroll-hijacking layers (smooth-scrollbar etc.) take detail on the element { offset, limit } Fires to make it move
options.State Class: is-fx-moving · is-fx-left · is-fx-right · is-fx-start · is-fx-end · is-fx-noscroll — used to show the hint text (first position only) and the back button (at the end)

note: The original received offset·limit from smooth-scrollbar turned horizontal. The site just needs to fire fx:scroll from scrollbar.addListener.

from.where: shared.js · shared.css .tk-spy (bottom-line neighborhood strip and red car on sub pages — original js_scrollspy carmove · rotate)
